# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest released version of Terrablade.
Older releases may receive a fix when practical, but they are not supported by
policy.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/gszzzzzz/terrablade/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue or discussion for an undisclosed vulnerability.

Include the affected version or commit, the operating system and architecture,
a minimal reproduction, the expected impact, and any known mitigation. Avoid
including secrets or unrelated user data in the report.

Reports are evaluated on a best-effort basis. You may be asked for additional
information while the issue is reproduced and assessed. Please allow time for
a fix and coordinated release before public disclosure.

Security-relevant reports include inputs that cause unintended file changes,
meaningful resource-exhaustion attacks beyond the documented limits, or a
violation of the formatter's stated integrity guarantees. Formatting
preferences, ordinary parse errors, and behavior already documented as a
resource limit can be reported through a regular issue.
